content.text: {"core": "Source is the doorway where a fresh turn arrives from outside the plan. In Discipline, that arrival lands inside steady solitary practice — the new enters the long routine of tending. Unnoticed, each arrival gets folded into the routine as more of the same, and the practice never bends to meet what came through.", "sheetLine": "Something new keeps coming in, and the steady routine swallows it unchanged."}
